viewof globalCalibRun = {
  const options = calib_runs_ojs;
  if (options.length === 0) {
    return Inputs.select([], {label: "Calibration Run:", disabled: true});
  }
  // Default to the run with the highest numeric ID (e.g. "C50" over "C33"),
  // not just the last entry in `options` -- that list comes from a plain
  // alphabetical sort (see list_available_runs in _validation_scripts.py),
  // which only happens to match numeric order today because both IDs have
  // the same digit count ("C9" would sort after "C50" alphabetically despite
  // being numerically earlier).
  const runNumber = id => {
    const m = /(\d+)/.exec(id);
    return m ? parseInt(m[1], 10) : -Infinity;
  };
  const latestRun = options.reduce((best, id) => runNumber(id) > runNumber(best) ? id : best, options[0]);
  const stored = window.localStorage.getItem("tdmcalib:selectedRun");
  const initial = options.includes(stored) ? stored : latestRun;
  const input = Inputs.select(options, {label: "Calibration Run:", value: initial});
  input.classList.add("calib-run-bar");
  input.addEventListener("input", () => {
    window.localStorage.setItem("tdmcalib:selectedRun", input.value);
  });

  // Quarto's own OJS runtime places this cell's returned node into its
  // normal in-page output slot right after this function returns -- moving
  // it into the sidebar synchronously, before that happens, would just get
  // undone a moment later. Deferring to the next tick runs this after that
  // placement, so the move actually sticks.
  setTimeout(() => {
    const sidebar = document.querySelector("#quarto-sidebar");
    const menu = sidebar?.querySelector(".sidebar-menu-container");
    if (!sidebar || !menu) return; // no docked sidebar -- stays inline as a .calib-run-bar
    input.classList.remove("calib-run-bar");
    input.classList.add("calib-run-sidebar");
    sidebar.insertBefore(input, menu);
  }, 0);

  return input;
}

viewof modeInput = Inputs.select(["Drive", "Walk"], {label: "Access Mode", value: "Drive"});
viewof metricInput = Inputs.select(["Access Distance (mi)", "Access Time (min)"], {label: "Metric", value: "Access Distance (mi)"});
viewof layersInput = Inputs.checkbox(["Target", "Modeled"], {label: "Show Data:", value: ["Target", "Modeled"]});
dataObs = transpose(crt_plot_data)
dataMod = transpose(crt_model_data).filter(d => d.calib_run === globalCalibRun)

// 2. Reactive Filtering
metricInfo = metricInput === "Access Distance (mi)"
  ? { col: "access_dist", label: "Distance (miles)", max: 10 }
  : { col: "access_time", label: "Time (minutes)", max: 30 };

filteredObs = dataObs.filter(d => d.Ac_Mode2_Model === modeInput);
filteredMod = dataMod.filter(d => d.Ac_Mode2_Model === modeInput);

// Calculate dynamic max domain
domainMax = Math.max(
  d3.max(filteredObs, d => d[metricInfo.col]) || 0,
  d3.max(filteredMod, d => d[metricInfo.col]) || 0
) * 1.05;

// 3. Render Merged Plot
Plot.plot({
  height: 900,
  marginLeft: 160,
  marginTop: 40,
  style: { fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif", fontSize: "13px", color: "#374151" },

  x: {
    label: metricInfo.label,
    labelOffset: 40,
    domain: [0, domainMax],
    grid: true,
    tickSize: 0,
    line: true
  },

  fy: {
    label: null,
    domain: station_list,
    padding: 0.1,
    tickFormat: d => d.replace(" Station", "")
  },

  y: {
    axis: "right",          // Move axis to the right side
    label: "Weighted Count", // Label what the height represents
    grid: true,             // Add horizontal grid lines to help compare peaks
    tickFormat: "s"         // Short format (e.g., 200, 1.5k) to save space
  },

  color: {
    domain: ["Target", "Modeled"],
    range: [themeTarget, themeModel],
    legend: true
  },

  marks: [
    // --- MODELED LAYER (Blue) ---
    layersInput.includes("Modeled") ? Plot.areaY(filteredMod, Plot.binX(
      { y: "sum" },
      {
        x: metricInfo.col,
        fy: "Stop_Name",
        weight: "boarding_weight",
        thresholds: 50,
        curve: "basis",
        fill: themeModel,
        fillOpacity: 0.5,
        sort: { fy: null }
      }
    )) : null,

    layersInput.includes("Modeled") ? Plot.lineY(filteredMod, Plot.binX(
      { y: "sum" },
      {
        x: metricInfo.col,
        fy: "Stop_Name",
        weight: "boarding_weight",
        thresholds: 50,
        curve: "basis",
        stroke: themeModel,
        strokeWidth: 1.5
      }
    )) : null,

    // --- TARGET LAYER (Amber) ---
    layersInput.includes("Target") ? Plot.areaY(filteredObs, Plot.binX(
      { y: "sum" },
      {
        x: metricInfo.col,
        fy: "Stop_Name",
        weight: "boarding_weight",
        thresholds: 50,
        curve: "basis",
        fill: themeTarget,
        fillOpacity: 0.5,
        sort: { fy: null }
      }
    )) : null,

    layersInput.includes("Target") ? Plot.lineY(filteredObs, Plot.binX(
      { y: "sum" },
      {
        x: metricInfo.col,
        fy: "Stop_Name",
        weight: "boarding_weight",
        thresholds: 50,
        curve: "basis",
        stroke: themeTarget,
        strokeWidth: 1.5
      }
    )) : null,

    // --- SHARED BASELINE ---
    Plot.ruleY([0], { stroke: "#e5e7eb", strokeWidth: 1 }),

    // --- MEDIANS ---
    layersInput.includes("Modeled") ? Plot.ruleX(filteredMod, Plot.groupZ(
      { x: "median" },
      {
        x: metricInfo.col,
        fy: "Stop_Name",
        weight: "boarding_weight",
        stroke: themeModel,
        strokeWidth: 2,
        strokeDasharray: "4,2",
        tip: {
          format: {
            x: (d) => `Median: ${d.toFixed(2)} ${metricInput.includes("Time") ? "min" : "mi"}`,
            fy: false,
            weight: false
          },
          fill: "white",
          stroke: "#374151",
          anchor: "bottom"
      }
      }
    )) : null,

    layersInput.includes("Target") ? Plot.ruleX(filteredObs, Plot.groupZ(
      { x: "median" },
      {
        x: metricInfo.col,
        fy: "Stop_Name",
        weight: "boarding_weight",
        stroke: themeTarget,
        strokeWidth: 2,
        strokeDasharray: "4,2",
        tip: {
          format: {
            x: (d) => `Median: ${d.toFixed(2)} ${metricInput.includes("Time") ? "min" : "mi"}`,
            fy: false,
            weight: false
          },
          fill: "white",
          stroke: "#374151",
          anchor: "bottom"
      }
      }
    )) : null
  ]
})
